title: Malevolent Force Horror
eyebrow: The Malevolent Force · more horror · round 4
heading: Your burnt hand, in your two shots
intro: You picked hand c, "use this hand but make it fit the scene", and the subtle VHS. Here hand c is put into your own picked stills (shot 4, the shelf; shot 6, the freezer), lit by the shop's teal light, with the same grain and the setting unchanged. The first option in each row is the shot as it is now. Pick one per shot; next they get animated: the hand snatches the card and the price changes.
